testcase.name: Scenario: extrusion-16 Intersect retains the circular common region: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/extrusion/extrusion.feature:171:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: extrusion-16 Intersect retains the circular common region ✔> Given the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace ✔> And the viewport pointer is idle ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-base-circle.opd` is open with its base solid and circular sketch on the top plane ✔ When Intersect is selected in Extrude ✔ Then Direction changes to Flipped and a cylindrical region is previewed ✔ When OK is clicked with Distance A 8 mm and zero taper ✔ Then the cylinder replaces the visible rectangular base result ✔ And the browser retains one solid body ✔ When Undo then Redo are invoked ✔ Then the base returns then the cylinder returns
